scope: One native atomic relative translation over selected existing 3D box instances, exact position numeric-token splices, isolated optional bridge and privately branded full-source proposal. No renderer/schema/backend/old-author domain change or source-save authority.

regression.scope: All studio-core*.test.mjs plus strict scene3d/transform/objects/environment/properties/translation pure proposal tests. Dedicated native path supplied for every parity test. Not a whole-application or GUI/GPU/device check.

contract.optionalProbe: viento_core_scene3d_translation_version() === 1; parse version one also required

receipt.order: all requested known targets in original declaration order, including partly/fully rounded targets; paths source object index then XYZ, net numeric changes only

contract.nativeMutation: Parse complete original source, select from one original model/CST, validate every final position -100000..100000, splice all changed position numeric tokens once, parse complete final source and enforce 128KiB original/final budget. Native zero/rounding no-op returns exact bytes and empty paths.
contract.bridgeWitness: Accessor-safe exact JSON request, detached input, full native before/after models, expected relative values and sourceordered receipt, immutable all nonnumeric/key/string/whitespace gaps and unchanged numeric lexemes; changed numbers are canonical and genuinely different. No YAML or JavaScript source parser import.
contract.proposal: createScene3DTranslationProposal / isScene3DTranslationProposal / prepareScene3DTranslationApply; independent WeakSet and deepfreeze, kind scene3d-translation, five-field source snapshot, beforeObjects/afterObjects complete selected declarations. No-op refuses proposal; source bytes/token/path/both revisions + asynchronous digest guards recompute full candidate, old four brands reject.

limitations: This primitive translation has no hierarchy, rotation/scale batch, gizmo, undo session or permanent Save operation.
Native/JS regression checks do not establish GUI/device/GPU or installed application acceptance.
Proposal captures caller DTOs before digest await; the source host must additionally recheck its live session and approval after that await.
